learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize themselves with the basic principles and methods of Crystallography so much in its practical use as much as in the basic understanding of the underlying mathematical principles.
Familiarize themselves with the crystal structure visualization software.
Familiarize themselves with the methodology of structural analysis of crystalline materials in Materials Science
Research, analyze and compile data and information using the appropriate software.
Promote free, creative and out-of-the-box thinking

syllabus_topics: Principles of X-ray diffraction
X-ray diffraction Instrumentation
Symmetry, Point groups and Space Groups
Bragg’s Law and Lattice Parameters
Systematic absences, Wyckoff positions and point multiplicity
Reciprocal Space and the Ewald sphere
Atomic structure factors and atomic displacement (Debye-Waller factor)
Structure Factor and the Phase problem
Powder diffraction: Data Collection
Powder diffraction: Data plotting and interpretation
Powder diffraction: Phase identification
Powder diffraction: Data Analysis - Pattern Matching
Powder diffraction: Data Analysis - Rietveld refinement
Single-Crystal diffraction: Data collection
Single-Crystal diffraction: Data indexing and data reduction
Single-Crystal diffraction: Space group determination and Structure solution
Single-Crystal diffraction: Structure refinement
Single-Crystal diffraction: Crystal structure visualization and presentation
2D X-ray diffraction patterns and Total Scattering: Data Collection
2D X-ray diffraction patterns and Total Scattering: Data plotting and interpretation
2D X-ray diffraction patterns and Total Scattering: G(r) vs r refinement
teaching_methods: Use of visualization and analysis software of the crystal structure (Jana2006, Vesta, CMPR, Platon)

assessment_methods.method: Final exam (structure determination of an unknown crystal structure and a 1-page structure report)

assessment_rules: Students will be evaluated with homework exercises and a final exam. The final exam will deal with the structure determination of an unknown crystal structure and a 1-page structure report.
